lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗੁ ਮਸਕਤੇ ਤੂਠੈ ਪਾਵਾ ਦੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhoo sa(n)g masakate toothai paavaa dev ||
lines.translation: The opportunity to work hard serving the Saadh Sangat is obtained, when the Divine Lord is pleased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਵਸਗਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੈ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣ ਕਰੇਵ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh vasagat saahibai aape karan karev ||
lines.translation: Everything is in the Hands of our Lord and Master; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੇਵ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kai balihaaranai manasaa sabh poorev ||3||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who fulfills all hopes and desires. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੋ ਦਿਸੈ ਸਜਣੋ ਇਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: iko disai sajano iko bhaaee meet ||
lines.translation: The One appears to be my Companion; the One is my Brother and Friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਸਾਮਗਰੀ ਇਕਸੈ ਦੀ ਹੈ ਰੀਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikasai dee saamagaree ikasai dee hai reet ||
lines.translation: The elements and the components are all made by the One; they are held in their order by the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਤਾ ਹੋਆ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas siu man maaniaa taa hoaa nihachal cheet ||
lines.translation: When the mind accepts, and is satisfied with the One, then the consciousness becomes steady and stable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਟੇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚੁ ਕੀਤੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭੫॥
lines.transliteration: sach khaanaa sach painanaa tek naanak sach keet ||4||5||75||
lines.translation: Then, one's food is the True Name, one's garments are the True Name, and one's Support, O Nanak, is the True Name. ||4||5||75||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੇ ਥੋਕ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜੇ ਆਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhe thok paraapate je aavai ik hath ||
lines.translation: All things are received if the One is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ ਜੇ ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam padaarath saphal hai je sachaa sabad kath ||
lines.translation: The precious gift of this human life becomes fruitful when one chants the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਰਾਪਤੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਥਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur te mahal paraapate jis likhiaa hovai math ||1||
lines.translation: One who has such destiny written on his forehead enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere man ekas siu chit laai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭ ਧੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਸਭ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekas bin sabh dha(n)dh hai sabh mithiaa mohu maai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the One, all entanglements are worthless; emotional attachment to Maya is totally false. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀਆ ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh khuseeaa paatisaaheeaa je satigur nadar karei ||
lines.translation: Hundreds of thousands of princely pleasures are enjoyed, if the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਏਕ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh ek har naam dei meraa man tan seetal hoi ||
lines.translation: If He bestows the Name of the Lord, for even a moment, my mind and body are cooled and soothed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਗਹੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis kau poorab likhiaa tin satigur charan gahe ||2||
lines.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny hold tight to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤੁ ਸਫਲਾ ਘੜੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਸਚੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saphal moorat saphalaa ghaRee jit sache naal piaar ||
lines.translation: Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful is that time, when one is in love with the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dookh sa(n)taap na lagaee jis har kaa naam adhaar ||
lines.translation: Suffering and sorrow do not touch those who have the Support of the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਹ ਪਕੜਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਢਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: baah pakaR gur kaadhiaa soee utariaa paar ||3||
lines.translation: Grasping him by the arm, the Guru lifts them up and out, and carries them across to the other side. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan suhaavaa pavit hai jithai sa(n)t sabhaa ||
lines.translation: Embellished and immaculate is that place where the Saints gather together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢੋਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਨੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਲਭਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhoee tis hee no milai jin pooraa guroo labhaa ||
lines.translation: He alone finds shelter, who has met the Perfect Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਧਾ ਘਰੁ ਤਹਾਂ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਜਨਮੁ ਜਰਾ ॥੪॥੬॥੭੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak badhaa ghar tahaa(n) jithai mirat na janam jaraa ||4||6||76||
lines.translation: Nanak builds his house upon that site where there is no death, no birth, and no old age. ||4||6||76||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਹਾਂ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee dhiaaeeai jeeaRe sir saahaa(n) paatisaahu ||
lines.translation: Meditate on Him, O my soul; He is the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਮਨ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਭਸੁ ਵੇਸਾਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis hee kee kar aas man jis kaa sabhas vesaahu ||
lines.translation: Place the hopes of your mind in the One, in whom all have faith.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਆਣਪਾ ਛਡਿ ਕੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh siaanapaa chhad kai gur kee charanee paahu ||1||
lines.translation: Give up all your clever tricks, and grasp the Feet of the Guru. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere sukh sahaj setee jap naau ||
lines.translation: O my mind, chant the Name with intuitive peace and poise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂੰ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਇੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar prabh dhiaai too(n) gun goi(n)d nit gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on God. Constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਰੁ ਮਨਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kee saranee par manaa jis jevad avar na koi ||
lines.translation: Seek His Shelter, O my mind; there is no other as Great as He.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਘਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਮੂਲੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis simarat sukh hoi ghanaa dukh darad na moole hoi ||
lines.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, a profound peace is obtained. Pain and suffering will not touch you at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa kar chaakaree prabh saahib sachaa soi ||2||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, work for God; He is our True Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਰਮਲਾ ਕਟੀਐ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat hoi niramalaa kateeai jam kee phaas ||
lines.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become absolutely pure, and the noose of death shall be cut away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaataa bhai bha(n)jano tis aagai kar aradaas ||
lines.translation: So offer your prayers to Him, the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of fear.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਹਰ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਕਾਰਜੁ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mihar kare jis miharavaan taa(n) kaaraj aavai raas ||3||
lines.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Merciful Master shall resolve your affairs. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਊਚੋ ਊਚਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahuto bahut vakhaaneeai oocho oochaa thaau ||
lines.translation: The Lord is said to be the Greatest of the Great; His Kingdom is the Highest of the High.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਰਨਾ ਚਿਹਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: varanaa chihanaa baaharaa keemat kahi na sakaau ||
lines.translation: He has no color or mark; His Value cannot be estimated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਸਚੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਅਪੁਣਾ ਨਾਉ ॥੪॥੭॥੭੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kau prabh maiaa kar sach devahu apunaa naau ||4||7||77||
lines.translation: Please show Mercy to Nanak, God, and bless him with Your True Name. ||4||7||77||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸ੍ਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: sreeraag mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੋ ਸੁਖੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam dhiaae so sukhee tis mukh oojal hoi ||
lines.translation: One who meditates on the Naam is at peace; his face is radiant and bright.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਲੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur te paaeeai paragat sabhanee loi ||
lines.translation: Obtaining it from the Perfect Guru, he is honored all over the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)gat kai ghar vasai eko sachaa soi ||1||
lines.translation: In the Company of the Holy, the One True Lord comes to abide within the home of the self. ||1||
